value.summary: EAVC-T1 makes external absorption value conversion durable. Future external repo/folder absorption must include a machine-checked External Absorption Value Conversion Matrix with DOCTRINE_ADAPTED, PACKAGE_CANDIDATE, RUNTIME_CANDIDATE, CHECKER_CANDIDATE, REJECT_DIRECT_IMPORT, and NO_PACKAGE_OR_RUNTIME_VALUE lanes. AGSK now records package/runtime/checker candidates explicitly; it does not claim any package or runtime activation.
